definitions.gloss: wallet case; wallet pouch; wallet holder
definitions.explanation: A protective case or pouch designed to hold a wallet, or a bag pocket specifically meant for storing one's wallet.

examples.english: I bought a leather wallet case.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{財布入|さいふい}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This bag has a wallet pocket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行中|りょこうちゅう}→旅行中：28581_ryokouchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{財布入|さいふい}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{下|さ}げて→下げる：00807_sageru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧スリ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}い→遭う：09500_au⟧にくい。
examples.english: When traveling, keeping your wallet in a case hung around your neck makes it harder for pickpockets to get it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧ (wallet) + ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (container, holder). Follows the common Japanese pattern of noun + ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ to mean a container for that item (e.g., ⟦{名刺|めいし}{入|い}れ→名刺入れ：27562_meishiire⟧ — business card case, ⟦{小銭|こぜに}{入|い}れ→小銭入れ：20896_kozeniire⟧ — coin purse, ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧{入|い}れ — pen case).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{財布入|さいふい}れ: leather wallet case
- {財布入|さいふい}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the wallet case
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧{掛|か}け{財布入|さいふい}れ: neck wallet/pouch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧: wallet — the wallet itself
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}{入|い}れ→小銭入れ：20896_kozeniire⟧: coin purse — a small container specifically for coins
- ⟦セキュリティ→セキュリティ：04867_sekyuriti⟧⟦ポーチ→ポーチ：09488_poochi⟧: security pouch — a travel pouch for valuables
